validate_manifests: Kubernetes and GitOps manifest contracts passed
checks: required kinds: Deployment, Service, ServiceAccount, ConfigMap, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, PodDisruptionBudget, NetworkPolicy, Gateway, HTTPRoute
container probes: readinessProbe, livenessProbe, resources, securityContext
drift_rollback: ArgoCD syncPolicy automated prune+selfHeal enables drift detection; rollback via changing targetRevision or kubectl rollout undo; evidence via git log and kubectl diff
ports: ports.template validated, compose config --quiet 0 for core and full
